caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate vessel, possibly a cream jug or small pitcher, centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object is rendered mostly in grayscale and black tones, with intricate details highlighting its three-dimensional form. The body of the vessel has elaborate floral and leaf patterns in relief along its surface, with clusters of flowers, berries, and curling leaves visible. The spout is on the left side, and the handle on the right is textured and appears to be shaped like intertwining branches or vines, matching the ornate theme of the body. The base of the jug is elliptical and smooth, contrasting with the detailed upper portion. The top edge of the vessel is bordered by a beaded or rope-like pattern. Near the bottom right of the image, the artist’s signature “F. Hastings” is visible. The overall composition places the vessel prominently in the center, with significant negative space surrounding it.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
